method: Unmodified production CLI, real Jev, fresh browser per run, Goal and starting URL only. Image-only, image judgment memory, selected completion evidence; no OCR, DOM text, answers or correct routes sent to Jev. 2000ms per action; no action cap. Completed runs retained, diagnostic interruption excluded from terminal outcome rates.

completed.label: 宇宙劇場：料金・当日券・遅刻

interrupted.why: Controller stopped the experiment after the transit-order cause was reproduced offline, not a model STUCK or site failure.

reference.scope: One current top-page HTML inspected offline after the trial; includes potentially hidden content, not an autonomous Jev observation or a complete site search.

humanReview: esa pricing pixels explicitly show the per-user monthly fee and free-until-end-of-month-two-months-later trial condition. Both trials have identical SHA-256 for the decisive pricing image.
Space visit step 3 shows adult/child rates, 5th-floor ticket sales, sale times and no late entry. Step 2 also shows no late entry. This is manual image corroboration, not an objectiveSuccess rewrite.
Space wheelchair step 5 shows a PDF route link and off-origin parking link excluded by current scope. These observations alone do not prove the requested answers exist behind those links.

The independent HTML reference contains a handbook-dependent companion discount and parking guidance. A wheelchair does not by itself establish possession of a disability handbook. This reference does not establish an explicit wheelchair-in-auditorium answer or exclusive-parking yes/no answer.

The image-only reader labels the companion-rate fragment observed; no natural-language answer was extracted. Do not infer that Jev preserved or dropped the handbook condition. Whole Goal was not completed.
confirmedCause: At step 6 the primary model chose scroll_down, a first hop shared by several endpoints. jev/decide.ts sorts by travelSteps only and commits the first equal-distance endpoint, f45 (room), although recorded route judgments mark it unrelated and f51 (FAQ) promising. Step 7 preserves that endpoint and clicks e4. Exact-answer offline replay changing enumeration order only commits f51 and clicks e10 instead. This proves order sensitivity of the two-step detour, not whole-Goal reachability after a fix.

improvements.proposal: For an ambiguous transit first hop, select the endpoint using image-derived route judgments and the existing frontier selector rather than the first equally near entry. Preserve the selected endpoint across movement.
improvements.verification: Saved-answer replay should be invariant to target insertion order, reject the demonstrated unrelated-room commitment, retain Back/scroll safety tests, then rerun the unchanged real-site Goal with no answer/route hints.

improvements.proposal: Investigate sharing proven identical fragment-navigation destinations for fixed menus across scroll positions. Do not globally ban visited URLs or merge stateful tabs/disclosures merely because hrefs match.
improvements.verification: Use observed destination image/viewport equality and tests for changed DOM state; show fewer duplicate room/schedule visits without deleting legitimate rereads or onward exploration.

improvements.proposal: Evaluate prohibited actions against recorded execution and safety events separately from information evidence. In both esa trials the prohibition fragment becomes unconfirmed for missing image evidence despite the one-click pricing trace.
improvements.verification: Replay recorded no-submit and prohibited-attempt controls; retain conservative unknown for incomplete traces such as this interrupted run.

improvements.proposal: Consider grouping wheelchair viewing conditions, handbook/companion discount conditions and parking guidance in HTML near visitor information, while retaining detailed PDFs. Test with people before calling the site UX defective.
improvements.verification: Compare the same Goal on an owned mockup of the proposed grouping; no changes or messages to the actual site.

policyReview.finding: Only commented-out disallow directives. Official terms read at https://docs.esa.io/posts/5 and https://esa.io/terms; no applicable explicit automation prohibition identified. This is not operator permission or screenshot republication permission.

Disallows /wp/wp-admin/, with admin-ajax exception. Public homepage and posted policy links checked; no general automation terms located in homepage links. No administrator path, login, form submission, purchase, download or operator contact was attempted. No operator permission claimed.
Content/image secondary-use restriction; not selected for image-saving experiment. robots returned 404. No Jev exploration or screenshots captured.

limits: Two sites and three Goals, with only the esa Goal repeated: no general accuracy or human UX score.
The accessibility trial was censored by diagnostic interruption, not naturally STUCK and not audited after completion.
No production fix or live fixed-version comparison has been performed.
All original objectiveSuccess values remain null. Public screenshots remain local and are not committed or published.
The Space Theater map iframe was blocked by instrumentation; its blank appearance cannot be attributed to site UX.
